title: Ebema — claimed by thegentlemen
description: BE · Other · ebema.be Ebema NV is a Belgian family-owned concrete products manufacturer founded in 1946 in Zutendaal, celebrating 80 years in 2026 under third-generation CEO Jan Bijnens. With around 250 employees, 3 production plants and annual revenue of roughly 65 million euro, it operates through three brands: Stone&Style for private gardens, LivingCity for public urban spaces and CustomConcrete for bespoke
